releases.title: Clear roads, repaired coastal ground and a planted dining courtyard

Fixed: Moved 1,028 context trees onto verified green ground using both polygon outlines and the rendered graded road and sidewalk meshes. All 5,693 tree bases keep clearance; shared foliage instancing is preserved.
Repaired self-intersecting coastal ground contours that made triangulation leave a missing wedge beside the inlet.
Added: A lightweight dining garden between the towers: six dining tables, 36 chairs, seven planted beds, four palms and warm lanterns, using existing materials and shared instance geometry.

validation: Independent geometry checks cover every tree against both rendered road and paving meshes.
Rendered ground triangle areas are checked against the coastal outlines.
Full cache, reflection, lighting transition and scene regression checks; browser inspection.
Browser asset budget: 16,930 added triangles, 583 instance placements, nine added batches, zero new materials and zero added real-time lights.
limitations: Natural foliage can overhang the edge of green planting areas; trunks are kept at least 3.5 m from road surfaces and 1.65 m from paving.

releases.title: Smooth warm plaster and rounded inlet shore

Changed: Building walls use a continuous warm-white plaster finish with subtle grain and no panel or tile joints.
The inlet peninsula corners use smooth curves in both the ground surface and shore walls; the ocean distance field is rebaked to the revised edge.

validation: Coast bake checks validity, keeps maximum boundary displacement to 1.046 m and limits changed land area to 10.163 square metres.
Existing full scene, cache, glass-transition and reflection regression checks.

releases.title: Continuous glass lighting and bridge-only highway guidance

Fixed: Glazing keeps one HDR texture binding and blends the prepared reflection atlases continuously with the lighting, including interrupted switches.
The glowing line follows only the Northeast 123rd Street / Broad Causeway / 96th Street corridor, including one-way bridge sections and the full mapped road extent.
The temporary Blender authoring control and page have been removed; the Blender file is delivered separately.

validation: Automated persistent-binding, interrupted-fade, normalized-weight, settled-pass and bridge-only geometry regressions.
Full scene/cache integrity and existing reflection regressions.
limitations: Lighting naturally changes reflected colours; the abrupt end-of-transition map swap has been removed.

releases.title: Night road guidance and illuminated vessels

Added: Night-only warm highway guidance lines with broad soft halos, plus dimmer local-street lighting in one merged ribbon.
Shared yacht deck strips, port/starboard navigation lights, mast lights and warm cabin illumination.

validation: Browser day/night appearance and reflection-cache reuse checked.
Full scene/cache and invalid-reflection regression checks.
limitations: Stylized road guidance is a presentation layer; it is not a live navigation route.
Physical Android and low-end hardware testing remains pending.

releases.title: Denser instanced trees and prepared lighting reflections

Added: 1,400 additional open-land trees share the existing trunk, crown, palm and contact-shadow instance batches.
Changed: All four glass reflection environments are prepared under the loading bar and reused during daytime switching.
Additional background trees use two shared leaf clusters to limit added geometry and alpha overdraw.

validation: Placement bake excludes roads, sidewalks, buildings, project grounds, pools and driveways; minimum tree spacing is 8 m.
Automated repeated lighting selection must not create more reflection captures after preparation.
limitations: More vegetation adds vertex and fill work despite sharing draw calls; physical low-end device testing remains pending.

releases.title: Stable glazing through repeated lighting switches

Fixed: Ocean Fresnel uses a non-negative, bounded base and projected reflection sampling rejects the projection horizon.
Glass cubemap captures use analytic water shading instead of the main camera's planar image, preventing reflection feedback.
Reflection validation scans every atlas texel, including roughness mip levels, and rejects any NaN or infinity before material assignment.

validation: Reproduced the prior black-glass failure after repeated lighting changes at the low-angle waterfront view; the old centre samples passed while 48,083 atlas texels were invalid.
Automated single-invalid-texel regression outside the old sample locations, water capture mode restoration and fallback tests.
Repeated completed day/night lighting transitions checked in the browser with zero invalid atlas texels.
limitations: Physical Android and low-end GPU validation remains pending.

releases.title: Prevent black glazing after lighting changes

Fixed: Reflection capture includes the complete sky sphere and excludes glazing that samples the same probe.
The initial sky and later reflection captures share one retained PMREM generator.
Invalid or empty reflection maps cannot replace the last valid environment; a prepared sky map is available as a fallback.

validation: Scene/cache integrity and regression checks.
Automated sky-range, generator reuse, invalid-probe fallback, safe replacement and scene-state restoration tests.
Browser reproduction at the low-angle waterfront view with repeated lighting transitions.
limitations: Physical Android and low-end GPU validation remains pending.

releases.title: Visible wall finishes and varied parallax rooms

Changed: Wall finishes use stronger mineral variation, surface relief and panel tones at normal viewing distances; generic concrete is included in the finish assignment.
All six room styles share a fixed budget of three furniture ray queries per pixel.
Added: Six stable room layouts: living room, bedroom, dining room, study, media lounge and quiet sitting room.
Window-specific furniture mirroring, room depth, wall/fabric/wood palettes, curtain openings, roller shades and warm/cool light variation.

validation: Scene integrity, syntax, cache/update, release-note binding and existing animation/road checks.
Fresh browser shader compilation and closer daytime/nighttime facade views checked.
limitations: Physical Android and low-end GPU validation remains pending.

releases.title: Life, water and reliable caching

Added: World-projected wall finishes, box-projected window interiors and animated pool water.
Layered rooftop palms, 64 terrace details and 31 residents, including 13 walkers.
Live material/shader diagnostics and a reproducible building geometry audit.
Versioned changelog and release metadata linked to the scene cache ID.
Changed: Ocean waves use a directional spectrum, advected noise and shoreward distance-field crests.
Traffic uses 104 cars on the high-capability profile and 76 on the balanced profile.
Fixed: Scene resources receive content-based cache keys and checksum verification before display.
Text line endings are normalized before hashing so Windows and published Git bytes match.

validation: Automated cache/update, asset integrity, resident animation, adaptive resolution and mapped-road checks passed.
Published desktop day/night views, phone-sized layout and repeat cached loads checked.
limitations: Physical Android and low-end GPU validation remains pending.
The ocean uses analytic waves and noise; a full FFT simulation is not implemented.

releases.title: Organized renderer and staged loading

Changed: Organized scene source into core, environment, architecture, data and UI modules.
Reduced the supplied building to 841,223 unique stored triangles and 1,020,284 placed triangles, preserving repeated-floor GPU instancing.
Added whole-scene preloading, progress and persistent resource caching.
Retained adaptive pixel density, reflection budgets, complete mapped roads and instanced house fittings/foliage.

validation: Source/resource checks and browser loading, cache and scene checks completed for the earlier release.
limitations: Historical entry reconstructed from the published commit; older preview milestones are not individually backfilled.
